description:
Relative expression of a wheat gene's A, B and D homoeologues per tissue/stage (Expression Atlas and expVIP
baseline experiments), with the homoeologue expression balance category of each tissue: balanced, A/B/D dominant
or A/B/D suppressed, by distance to the ideal proportions (Ramirez-Gonzalez et al. 2018). Categories are given only
for 1:1:1 triads with summed TPM >= 0.5. Without experiment: every tissue of the 209-sample expVIP developmental
atlas (EXPVIP-Development, 70 tissue/stage groups of cv. Azhurnaya) plus the category counts of every other
experiment and an overall summary; experiment restricts to one accession with all its tissues.
name: wheat_homoeologue_expression
